crossRefs.note: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
translations.bsb: The Benjamites rallied to Abner, formed a single unit, and took their stand atop a hill.
translations.kjv: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
translations.asv: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
